rules.statement: Keep the first clean delivery of a repeated line and cut the repeats.
Never cut a sentence that carries a negation; flag it for a person instead.

structure.closing_style: One-line recap, then the call to action.
structure.hook_style: Open with a question aimed at the viewer.
